{{Top|leg}}The [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] '''Rapid 12 Cybernetic Reflex System''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant that greatly increased reaction time to outside stimuli and threats.

Consisting of a series of specialized implants to stimulate and help regulate the sympathetic nervous system of the user, the implant reduced the latency of neural communication between the sensory organs and brainstem, resulting in greatly improved reaction time.
